explanation: Parametrize C by x=2cos(t), y=2sin(t), 0≤t≤π. Then dx=-2sin(t)dt and dy=2cos(t)dt, so x²y dx+x dy=4cos²(t)(1-4sin²(t))dt, giving option a directly. Option b has the same integral value by the substitution t↦π-t and symmetry interchanging sin² and cos² over [0,π]; this does not affect the validity of a.
